title: Graduated safety pipeline for private control plane version promotions
creator: Priya Ramaswamy
description: Problem: Private (VPC) customers require predictable, low-risk control plane upgrades. Today we rely on ad-hoc runbooks and manual traffic steering for tenant promotion, which causes variability in upgrade duration and increases on-call load. Goal: build a graduated / staged promotion pipeline that automates Terraform/IaC gating, preflight validation, canary exposure, and automated rollback scoring so a single upgrade can be promoted from dry-run -> shadow -> partial-live -> full-promotion with minimal manual steps.
acceptance_criteria:
1) A reproducible terraform-based promotion pipeline exists that can be executed from CI or the Console UI.
2) Preflight dry-run stage evaluates plan diffs and blocks on any change flagged as 'incompatible' by the compatibility generator.
3) Shadow stage mirrors traffic for a configurable tenant cohort and runs synthetic probes + KV cache warmups.
4) Canary scoring service computes a health score using latency, error rate, p99 tail, and custom tenant SLOs and prevents promotion if score drops below threshold.
5) Dashboard and long-lived audit log entries are created for each promotion event.
6) Ability to auto-rollback and auto-quarantine tenants based on scoring thresholds with a single operator action.
7) End-to-end tests (staging pipeline) validate rollback path and terraform plan gating before the release date.
implementation_plan: Design and deliver a terraform module (priv-upgrade-pipeline) that encapsulates plan-run, apply-run, and promotion metadata (8h).
Build a compatibility artifact generator that analyzes control plane operator image, CRD changes, and runtime kernel compatibility and emits a pass/warn/fail matrix (2d).
Add a CI preflight job that runs terraform plan against a cloned namespace + simulated state; feed the plan into the compatibility generator and fail the pipeline on 'fail' artifacts (1d).
Implement a lightweight traffic siphon component that can mirror or siphon X% of tenant traffic to the new control plane variant while preserving affinity and rate limits (3d).
Create a canary scoring microservice that ingests Console telemetry (latency, errors, token counts) and returns a promotion decision score. Plug into the pipeline as an automated gate (2d).
Integrate synthetic probe harness to exercise common control-plane flows: token issuance, model routing, autoscaler hooks, snapshot reconcile, and KV cache warmup (2d).
Wire the pipeline to Console: promotion UI, audit logs, and an emergency rollback button that triggers terraform apply to revert and quarantines affected tenants (1d).
Author runbooks, playbooks, and test scenarios; schedule a staged rollout to internal tenants before broader customer rollout (1d).
